App Manager Tech is local-only. Below is the exhaustive list of what this app reads, what it stores, and what it sends. There is nothing else.
What we read from your device

The list of installed apps (label, version, package name, install / update / last-used dates, install source, declared permissions, signing certificate). Source: Android PackageManager + StorageStatsManager + UsageStatsManager.
App sizes: install / data / cache bytes per package. Requires PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS granted in OS Settings.
What we store on your device
A cache of the catalogue in a private SQLite database (Room). Refreshed by the background scan worker or on demand. Excluded from cloud backup.
Your preferences (theme, scan cadence, ignore list, etc.) in DataStore Preferences. Excluded from cloud backup.
What we send off your device
Nothing. The app does not request the INTERNET permission. It cannot open a network socket — Android enforces this at the OS level.

Zero. No Google Mobile Services, no Firebase, no analytics, no crash reporter that phones home, no advertising library. Every dependency is open source under Apache 2.0 / MIT / BSD. Full list in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
Source code, build recipe, threat model, and changelog are public on GitHub. Anyone can audit, reproduce the build byte-for-byte, fork, and redistribute under Apache 2.0.
